newsitem.title: USA: US debt futures end down before Greenspan's speech.
newsitem.headline: US debt futures end down before Greenspan's speech.

text.p: U.S. debt futures closed lower in light consolidative trade ahead of Fed chairman Greenspan's speech Thursday evening, traders said.

Despite the Fed's "black-out period" before the Federal Open Market Committee's (FOMC) meeting Tuesday, traders were concerned Greenspan may offer clues on the pace of U.S. economic growth and monetary policy during his speech at 1900 EDT/2300 GMT.
"The market is continually adjusting with regards to what the Fed will do," Barrett Lewald, senior financial futures strategist at Lind-Waldock Inc, said.
Tuesday, bonds and Eurodollars began adjusting for at least a 25-basis-point rate next week after a senior Fed official said eight out of 12 Fed banks submitted requests for a discount rate hike.
December T-bonds USZ6 fell to 107-14/32, while December EDZ6 and March Eurodollars EDH7 have steadily inched lower on good dealer selling.
Selling pressure, however, dried up by midday. Not even the rise in the Futures Inflation Gauge (FIG) incited a late round of selling ahead of Greenspan's speech, traders said.
The Economic Cycle Research Institute's (ECRI) FIG rose to 106.3 in the week ended Sept 6 from a revised 105.3 in the previous week.
Several U.S. economic reports released this morning also confirmed that inflationary pressures were growing in the U.S. economy.

The rise in the prices paid component in the Philadelphia Fed's business outlook, coupled with the increase in the August U.S. housing starts, kept offers in both the bond and Eurodollar futures pits, traders said. Housing starts rose to their highest level since March 1994.
Starts rose 4.5 percent to an annual rate of 1.525 million units, compared to the average trade estimate of 1.445 million units and July's rate of 1.46 million units.

At the end of pit trade, December bonds were down 13/32 at 107-21/32, with 10-year notes off 7/32 at 106-08/32, December Eurodollars one basis point lower at 94.06, March Eurodollars down three basis points at 93.88 and March T-bills four basis points lower at 94.43.
